# StrengthLog Support Area

> > Support hub for StrengthLog App, a fitness tracking application for strength training, workout programs, and performance metrics.

This support site provides comprehensive guides and FAQs for using the StrengthLog App, covering everything from basic account setup to advanced features like custom program building, strength level comparisons, and workout challenges. The documentation helps users maximize their strength training experience through proper use of tracking tools, calculators, and gamification features.

## Key Topics

- StrengthLog App
- Workout tracking
- Strength levels
- Performance tracking
- Custom workout programs
- Personal records
- Account management
- Fitness metrics
- Challenges and gamification
- Powerlifting calculators
- Exercise directory
- Premium features
- User settings

## Getting Started

- [StrengthLog Support Area – FAQ's and Guides for StrengthLog App](https://help.strengthlog.com): Main support hub for StrengthLog App with FAQs and user guides
- [Manage Your Account – Username, Email and Password, or Delete Account](https://help.strengthlog.com/help-article/manage-your-account): Account management guide for username, email, password, and deletion

## Workout Programs & Training

- [How to Build a Program In the StrengthLog App](https://help.strengthlog.com/help-article/how-to-build-a-program): Step-by-step guide to creating custom workout programs in the app
- [Train Again](https://help.strengthlog.com/help-article/train-again): Guide to repeating workouts with bulk modifications (premium feature)
- [How Do I Change or Delete an Exercise?](https://help.strengthlog.com/help-article/how-do-i-change-delete-an-exercise): Tutorial for managing custom exercises in workout directory

## Performance Tracking & Metrics

- [Personal Records and Yearly Records](https://help.strengthlog.com/help-article/personal-records-and-yearly-records): How to track and view personal bests and yearly records per exercise
- [Strength Levels](https://help.strengthlog.com/help-article/strength-levels): Guide to comparing performance with other users via strength levels
- [How to Use the StrengthLogs Calculators](https://help.strengthlog.com/help-article/calculators): Tutorial for using calculators including powerlifting meet attempt planner

## App Features & Gamification

- [Challenges In the StrengthLog App](https://help.strengthlog.com/help-article/challenges): Guide to app challenges feature for gamified workout motivation
